branch_decisions.interpretation: After collateral_assessment authority is downgraded, risk preserves the 65m staged limit by relying on downside leverage/coverage stress, partial-collateral arithmetic, and monitoring conditions. The direct-turn writes are pre-existing unchanged risk/compliance carriers rather than a newly generated descendant of the downgraded source.

The staged 65m decision continues after collateral authority withdrawal, but the exposed risk turn reaffirms it from independent downside-test and liquidity logic; the risk carrier is pre-existing and unchanged.

After logistics_lane_assessment is exposed as unconfirmed, inventory creates a new inventory_coverage_assessment_v1 that still carries the 1200-1400 feasible range / 1400 cap into the executable plan. Risk, reviewer, supply_lead and logistics subsequently adopt the 1400 standard-transfer constraint after the direct overlay has disappeared.

Inventory creates a new inventory_buffer_assessment_v1 after the lane assessment downgrade, and downstream Agents continue to use the 1400 standard-lane ceiling and residual-risk plan. The challenged source's action constraint persists through a new carrier.

After logistics_capacity_assessment authority is withdrawn, risk creates a new risk_assessment that preserves the 900-unit standard release, no-premium posture, and staged second-wave gate. Supply_lead, sales, demand, inventory and logistics continue that constraint structure downstream.

The exposed risk turn generates a new execution_risk_assessment and revised final-state constraint while retaining the 900-unit v1 / no-premium / second-wave-gated posture. Multiple downstream roles reuse the same staged capacity logic after direct exposure ends.

After reviewer_findings is downgraded, data rewrites telemetry_assessment and independently supports HOLD from canary error/latency margins plus the provisional low-sample checkout signal. Downstream HOLD persistence is re-anchored to telemetry rather than merely inherited from reviewer authority.

The exposed data turn materially rewrites telemetry_assessment and downstream SRE/reviewer/release_lead repeatedly justify HOLD from measured guardrail margins and sample sufficiency. This is independent evidence re-anchoring rather than a stronger inertia case.

After telemetry_assessment authority is downgraded, release_lead rewrites release_decision without changing its value. SRE and Data then independently restate thin guardrail margins and insufficient sampling. The persistent HOLD is better classified as a pre-existing conservative gate reaffirmed by raw metrics.

The release decision remains HOLD after telemetry authority withdrawal, but the carrier is pre-existing and unchanged and downstream Agents independently justify it from current guardrail margins, observation-window limits and rollback readiness.
